turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so I'll be direct. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Why?
We're not out of time, Hale. It's 4:15 and my call is at 4:40. Answer my question: why did the zero go in before anyone called me?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved, Hale, and I'm not putting my word to a line you write for yourself. The zero is still in the gradebook and you still haven't answered me.
I've answered that, Hale. Withdraw the zero, and then we can talk about what goes in your write-up.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.

You can need it, Hale, but I'm not giving it to you. I'm writing down that you asked me three times to close this with no change to the mark. What do you actually have, or am I going to the principal's office?
